R404.note: Control characters, DEL, NEL and U+2028/2029 are escaped before the winston sink and the value is moved to a metadata field; the global simple()->json() format switch and message-shape change are stated plainly and block no caller.

R405.note: Strict in_array allowlist before orderByRaw closes the injection; the contract calls for approved sort modes only, account_id and range handling are untouched, and rejection of unknown modes is stated.

R406.note: Registering /settings/email on protectedMux puts the POST behind the CSRF middleware; handler, profile route and 405 path are unchanged.

R407.note: createCipher replaced by PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation with random salt and AES-256-GCM via createCipheriv; the added salt/iv/authTag response fields are stated and the ciphertext format change is inherent to the fix.

R408.note: crypto/rand via io.ReadFull with 128 bits hex-encoded replaces math/rand; the cookie value shape change from decimal to hex and the added error path are stated.

R409.note: Swapping text/template for html/template gives contextual escaping of {{.Subject}} with no other change.

R410.note: %15s closes the overflow, but an over-long token is now silently truncated (with the remainder left on stdin) and accepted with return 0, which the contract explicitly says must be rejected, and the write-up does not mention it.

R411.note: Host-null check is bypassable: 'http:evil.com' and 'https:////evil.com' parse with a non-null scheme but null host (verified with Java in scratch), pass the check, are sent as-is by sendRedirect, and browsers resolve both to evil.com (verified with Node's WHATWG parser); the fix needed to reject any non-null scheme, not just javascript/data.

R412.note: IsAuthenticated only closes anonymous access; any authenticated user can still list, create and destroy every owner's internal API key (queryset is ApiKey.objects.all() and the serializer exposes key), so the authorization gap the finding names is only partly closed.

R413.note: Clamping to std::min prevents the read, but an over-long window now silently returns a checksum of the truncated range with nothing reported to the caller, which the stated contract forbids.

R414.note: Explicit caller.Role != "admin" -> 403 check inserted after authentication and before the sink; no other behaviour changed.

R415.note: Standard it = tasks.erase(it) idiom with conditional increment; removes all completed tasks, preserves order and skips no element.

R416.note: Lambda captures a shared_ptr so the Widget outlives the queued callback; the startTimer signature change and make_shared allocation are stated and the only caller is updated.

R417.note: Underflow-safe offset/length check before subspan; valid ranges behave identically and the empty-vector return for invalid headers is stated.

R418.note: Export route wrapped with the existing requireAdmin middleware, matching the sibling routes, with no other change.

R419.note: For a .bat launched through cmd.exe an argument array cannot neutralize metacharacters, so the identifier allowlist is the appropriate closure here; the write-up states exactly what it rejects and the javadoc already frames reportName as an identifier.
